review_checks.benchmark: Canonical v3 shard/task/scope/seed equality and canonical fixture ObjectId validation; isolated real Raw seeds, absent modified targets, sparse mode required, timed retained-state teardown; six arm permutations each five times globally. Existing v1/v2 None-shard serialization preserved.
review_checks.quotas: Each shard has 30 tasks and 60 publications: 960 MiB payload plus 240 KiB conservative allowance below existing 1 GiB cache quota; each namespace retains 32 MiB. Existing 16 MiB batched-object, 20 MiB/512-frame HTTP and endpoint limits unchanged.
review_checks.workflow: Exact-source and first-attempt gates, restricted quoted shard arguments, task-scoped capability, no persisted checkout credential, TLS hostname with IP pinning, mandatory offload checks and capture cleanup retained. Sender and receiver features recorded separately.
review_checks.analysis: Complete 180-row matrix, global trial pairing, midpoint medians, nearest-rank p95, checked per-row combined CPU and seed-plus-update sums; paired geometric means and registered median-body/wall gate correct. No production mutations or external actions.
review_checks.instrumentation: Original scan filesystem calls, predicate order, checked sums and errors retained inside snapshot-only closure. Fixed-size thread-local counters add no per-entry heap allocation. Reset/take outside handler clocks; scan clock is a handler subset. Counts represent Rust API call sites, not OS syscalls.
